sample_unit: cases (90 MRI images, three planes per case)

links.outcome: Differential diagnosis inclusion of correct tumor type on MRI interpretation by ChatGPT-4o
links.effect: Meningioma in differential for 73.3% of meningioma cases; glioma in 83.3% of glioblastoma cases; tumor localized correctly in 66.7% of cases.
links.quote: ChatGPT included meningioma in the differential diagnosis for 73.3% of meningioma cases and glioma in 83.3% of glioblastoma cases.

screen.reason: The study empirically assesses the performance of a multimodal LLM (ChatGPT-4o) on MRI image interpretation and treatment recommendations for simulated patient questions, evaluated by clinicians offline without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
